verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਇਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਕੇਰੀ ਘੇਰੀ ਆਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਹੁਇ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨੈਨ ਛਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baaree bahu naik kee naikaa piaaree keree gheree aan prabal hui ni(n)dhraa nain chhai kai ||

en.bdb: Known as favourite and loved one of the Master who has many women, when her turn to receive her Master's blessings came she was over-powered by the sleep of ignorance. The sleep-filled eyes made me unaware of everything.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮਨੀ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਾ ਚਈਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਆਗਮ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਾਦਰ ਕੈ ਸੋਈ ਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: premanee patibrataa chieelee priaa aagam kee ni(n)dhraa ko niraadhar kai soiee na bhai bhai kai ||

en.bdb: But those Sikh sentient beings who were filled with love in their hearts when they heard that their Master was coming, they forsake sleep and remained alert in their faith and love for the meeting.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਹੁਤੀ ਸੋਤ ਥੀ ਭਈ ਗਈ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਕ ਪੈ ਜਹਾ ਕੇ ਤਹਾ ਲੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sakhee hutee sot thee bhiee giee sukhadhaik pai jahaa ke tahaa le raakhe sa(n)gam sulai kai ||

en.bdb: Despite being favourite of my Master, I remained sleeping in ignorance. I remained bereft of meeting my comfort-giving beloved. I remained wherever I was, separated and bereft of His love and blessings. This is what sleep of ignorance did to me.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪਨ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਮਿਲਨ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਮ ਰੂਪ ਜਾਮਿਨੀ ਨ ਨਿਬਰੈ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੨੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: supan charitr mai na mitreh milan dheenee jam roop jaaminee na nibarai bihai kai ||219||

en.bdb: This dream like happening did not let me meet my beloved. Now the death-like night of separation neither ends nor terminates. (219)
